rationale.automation-bias: Synthesizes evidence on complacency, conformity, excessive trust, and expert failures.
rationale.oversight-theater: Shows nominal HITL fails under workload, disempowerment, and intervention disincentives.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Proposes verification quotas, intervention expectations, training, and performance safeguards.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Analyzes how explanations aid judgment yet can paradoxically increase misplaced trust.
rationale.org-governance: Recommends organization-wide hiring, training, workload, incentives, and assessment requirements.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Connects HITL implementation to EU law, NIST guidance, and standards.
rationale.counterpoint: Opposes assumptions that merely inserting human oversight ensures effective governance.
